description: Generated by BetterCmdTab 26.7. Keys mirror the Switcher.* preferences (prefix stripped); unknown keys are ignored, absent keys keep their current value.

$schema.description: Location of this schema. Ignored as a setting.

animationsEnabled.description: Glide the panel, the tiles and the tab strip between states. Off, or with macOS Reduce Motion on, every change is a hard cut.

appExceptions.description: Per-app rules. An app with no entry follows the global settings.

bundleID.description: Bundle identifier of the app this rule applies to.

hide.description: Whether this app is hidden from the switcher.

ignore.description: Whether the switcher shortcut is passed through to this app instead of opening the panel.

applicationsOnly.description: Show one entry per app instead of one per window.

backdropMaterial.description: Blur material behind the rows. Ignored by the macOS 26 glass backdrop.

backtickReversesAppSwitching.description: Use the window-switch shortcut (⌘`) to step backwards through apps.

boldSelectedLabel.description: Show the highlighted entry's title in bold.

browserTabMRU.description: Track browser tabs in the recency order.

browserTabPreviews.description: Show thumbnails for browser tabs in the Previews layout.

browserTabRowLimit.description: Cap on tab entries per browser window. 0 = unlimited; anything else is taken as 2…16.

clickOutsideToDismiss.description: Click outside the panel to dismiss it without switching.

commitSoundName.description: macOS system sound played on commit. A custom sound file stays on the Mac that chose it.

currentSpaceOnly.description: Legacy "only the current Space" flag, kept in sync with spaceScope for older builds. Edit spaceScope instead.

cycleTileWidths.description: Repeating the tile-left/right shortcut cycles the window through half → two-thirds → one-third width.

directActivationBindings.description: Bundle ID activated by each direct-activation slot, in slot order. An empty string leaves the slot unused.

displayMode.description: Which monitor the switcher opens on.

excludedBundleIDs.description: Legacy always-hidden bundle IDs, folded into appExceptions at launch. Edit appExceptions instead.

expandBrowserTabsAsWindows.description: List browser tabs (Safari, Chromium) as separate entries.

expandTabsAsWindows.description: List native system tabs (Finder, Terminal, TextEdit, …) as separate entries.

experimentalBrowserTabMRU.description: Legacy browser-tab recency flag, kept in sync with browserTabMRU for older builds. Edit browserTabMRU instead.

experimentalBrowserTabPreviews.description: Legacy browser-tab-preview flag, kept in sync with browserTabPreviews for older builds. Edit browserTabPreviews instead.

experimentalInstantSpaceSwitch.description: Legacy instant-Space-switch flag, kept in sync with instantSpaceSwitch for older builds. Edit instantSpaceSwitch instead.

experimentalLivePreviews.description: Legacy live-preview flag, kept in sync with livePreviews for older builds. Edit livePreviews instead.

experimentalUnreadBadges.description: Legacy unread-badge flag, read once to seed showUnreadBadges. Edit showUnreadBadges instead.

fontFace.description: Typeface used for names and titles.

fontScale.description: Size of the name/title text, independent of the panel scale.

fuzzySearchRankBestMatchFirst.description: Sort search results by match quality instead of keeping the list order.

gridMaxColumns.description: Column cap for the grid layout. 0 = automatic (as many as fit).

gridSingleRow.description: Keep the grid on one row, shrinking the icons to fit, instead of wrapping. Ignored while gridMaxColumns caps the columns.

hapticOnCommit.description: Tap the trackpad when the switcher commits a selection.

hideAllExcludedBundleIDs.description: Bundle IDs the "hide all windows" shortcut leaves visible.

hideFromScreenSharing.description: Keep the switcher panel out of screen recordings and shared screens.

hoverActionsEnabled.description: Show action buttons on the entry under the pointer.

hoverShowForceQuit.description: Include "force quit" among the hover actions.

hoverShowHide.description: Include "hide app" among the hover actions.

instantSpaceSwitch.description: Switch Spaces without the macOS animation.

layoutMode.description: Switcher layout: list rows, an icon grid, or window previews.

letterChainTimeoutMs.description: How long a typed letter-jump prefix stays active before it expires (milliseconds).

letterHintsEnabled.description: Show the letter that jumps to each entry.

listWidthPercent.description: Width of list rows as a percentage of the automatic, screen-scaled width.

livePreviews.description: Keep window previews refreshing while the panel is open. Costs CPU/GPU; needs macOS 14 or later.

mouseClickSelectionEnabled.description: Click an entry to switch to it.

mouseHoverSelectionEnabled.description: Highlight the entry under the pointer.

nextScopedShortcutID.description: Internal counter for allocating scoped-shortcut ids. Never decreases, so a removed id is never reused. Don't edit.

panelAppearance.description: Light or dark switcher, independent of the rest of macOS.

panelCornerRadius.description: Panel corner radius in points. 0 = automatic (follows the panel size), -1 = square corners.

panelOpacity.description: Opacity of the panel background, in percent.

panelScalePercent.description: Overall size of the switcher panel, in percent. 100% matches the macOS switcher.

panelSize.description: Legacy size preset, migrated to panelScalePercent at launch. Use panelScalePercent instead.

pinnedBundleIDs.description: Bundle IDs pinned to the front of the switcher, in the order they appear.

previewTitleAlignment.description: Where the title sits under each window-preview tile.

recentlyClosedLimit.description: How many recently closed apps to offer. 0 disables them.

revealDelayMs.description: How long the shortcut must be held before the panel appears — a quicker tap switches without showing it (milliseconds).

scopedShortcutList.description: Scoped switcher shortcuts — each opens the panel already filtered to one subset of windows.

id.description: Stable id of this entry, as a decimal string. Keys its recorded trigger and its shortcutOverrides entry — never reused.

name.description: Name the trigger chord is recorded under (the chord itself is stored outside this file).

scopedShortcutScopes.description: Legacy fixed scoped-shortcut slots, migrated to scopedShortcutList. Edit scopedShortcutList instead.

searchDismissMode.description: Whether searching keeps the switcher open after the modifier is released.

searchIncludesLaunchableApps.description: Include installed apps that aren't running, so search can launch them.

selectionColor.description: Color of the selection highlight and the quick-jump letters. "system" follows the macOS accent; "custom" uses selectionColorHex.

selectionColorHex.description: Selection color used when selectionColor is "custom", as #RRGGBB. Falls back to the macOS accent when absent or malformed.

shiftTapStepsBackward.description: Tap Shift while switching to step backwards.

shortcutOverrides.description: Per-shortcut overrides of the global settings. Each entry names its shortcut in "target"; every other field is optional and inherits the global value when absent.

applicationsOnly.description: Override: Show one entry per app instead of one per window.

backdropMaterial.description: Override: Blur material behind the rows. Ignored by the macOS 26 glass backdrop.

boldSelectedLabel.description: Override: Show the highlighted entry's title in bold.

expandBrowserTabsAsWindows.description: Override: List browser tabs (Safari, Chromium) as separate entries.

fontFace.description: Override: Typeface used for names and titles.

fontScale.description: Override: Size of the name/title text, independent of the panel scale.

gridMaxColumns.description: Override: Column cap for the grid layout. 0 = automatic (as many as fit). Accepted: 0…12. Written as a decimal string.

layoutMode.description: Override: Switcher layout: list rows, an icon grid, or window previews.

letterHintsEnabled.description: Override: Show the letter that jumps to each entry.

listWidthPercent.description: Override: Width of list rows as a percentage of the automatic, screen-scaled width. Accepted: 30…100. Written as a decimal string.

panelAppearance.description: Override: Light or dark switcher, independent of the rest of macOS.

panelCornerRadius.description: Override: Panel corner radius in points. 0 = automatic (follows the panel size), -1 = square corners. Accepted: -1…40. Written as a decimal string.

panelOpacity.description: Override: Opacity of the panel background, in percent. Accepted: 30…100. Written as a decimal string.

panelScalePercent.description: Override: Overall size of the switcher panel, in percent. 100% matches the macOS switcher. Accepted: 35…150. Written as a decimal string.

panelSize.description: Legacy size preset, read once and migrated to panelScalePercent.

previewTitleAlignment.description: Override: Where the title sits under each window-preview tile.

showApplicationNames.description: Override: Show application names next to the icons.

showUnreadBadges.description: Override: Show each app's Dock unread badge on its entry.

showWindowless.description: Override: Include running apps that have no open window.

showWindowStatusIcons.description: Override: Show the hidden, minimized, full-screen and no-window glyphs on each entry.

showWindowTitleLabel.description: Override: Show each window's title, not just its app.

sortOrder.description: Override: Order apps and windows are listed in.

spaceScope.description: Override: which Spaces windows are pulled from. "inherit" follows the global spaceScope.

stayOpenOnQuickTap.description: Override: Also keep it open after a quick tap of the shortcut.

stayOpenOnRelease.description: Override: Keep the switcher open after the modifier is released.

titleTruncationMode.description: Override: Which part of a too-long title is replaced by an ellipsis.

showApplicationNames.description: Show application names next to the icons.

showBrowserIconOnTabs.description: Badge each browser-tab entry's favicon with the source browser's icon.

showRecentlyClosed.description: Offer recently closed apps in search so they can be reopened.

showUnreadBadges.description: Show each app's Dock unread badge on its entry.

showWindowlessApps.description: Include running apps that have no open window.

showWindowStatusIcons.description: Show the hidden, minimized, full-screen and no-window glyphs on each entry.

showWindowTitleLabel.description: Show each window's title, not just its app.

sinkHiddenApps.description: Move hidden apps to the bottom of the list instead of leaving them in place.

sinkMinimizedWindows.description: Move minimized windows to the bottom of the list instead of leaving them in their most-recently-used position.

sortOrder.description: Order apps and windows are listed in.

soundOnCommit.description: Play a sound when the switcher commits a selection.

spaceScope.description: Which Spaces windows are pulled from.

stayOpenOnQuickTap.description: Also keep it open after a quick tap of the shortcut.

stayOpenOnRelease.description: Keep the switcher open after the modifier is released.

swipeCommitOnRelease.description: Commit the swipe selection when the fingers lift.

swipeSensitivity.description: How far fingers must slide to advance one app. Higher = more sensitive.

tabDrillEnabled.description: Peek the highlighted window's tabs with the Peek tabs key.

titleRefreshIntervalMs.description: Delay before window titles in the open switcher catch up after an app renames one (milliseconds). Lower reacts sooner, higher costs less CPU.

titleTruncationMode.description: Which part of a too-long title is replaced by an ellipsis.

vimNavigationEnabled.description: Navigate with h/j/k/l as well as the arrow keys.

windowDrillEnabled.description: Peek the highlighted app's windows with ↓ while "applications only" is on.
